name: Punjab
tagline: The Land of Five Rivers, Where History Meets Vibrancy

topAttractions.name: Golden Temple
topAttractions.description: A stunning gurudwara (Sikh temple) made of white marble, surrounded by a pool of water and beautiful gardens.

topAttractions.name: Jallianwala Bagh
topAttractions.description: A historic site that commemorates the 1919 Amritsar Massacre, a pivotal event in India's struggle for independence.

topAttractions.name: Harike Lake
topAttractions.description: A large wetland and bird sanctuary, home to over 200 species of birds and a popular spot for boating and birdwatching.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March, when the weather is mild and pleasant, making it ideal for sightseeing and outdoor activities.
culturalFact: Punjab is home to the traditional craft of Phulkari embroidery, a intricate and colorful form of embroidery that is a UNESCO-recognized intangible cultural heritage of humanity.

hiddenGem.name: Kila Raipur Sports Festival
hiddenGem.description: A unique festival that showcases traditional Punjabi sports and games, such as camel racing and wrestling.

relatedFestival: Baisakhi, a major Sikh festival that celebrates the harvest season and the birth of the Khalsa (the Sikh community).
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from the Golden Temple or the Wagah Border, you'll love exploring the rich history and culture of Punjab!
